name: @streamarr-tv/app-webos
description: The full Playarr web client packaged as an installable LG webOS TV application.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs
scripts.package:ipk: pnpm --filter @streamarr-tv/app-webos... run build && ares-package dist -o out
